title: MJ12 memos reference CIC involvement at Roswell

tellings.quote: Leaked MJ12 memos from the 1940s reference CIC involvement in UFO investigations, including Roswell.

plain: Leaked papers said to come from MJ12, a supposed secret US committee set up to handle crashed UFOs, refer to the Counter Intelligence Corps, a US Army security unit, investigating UFOs in the 1940s, including the reported crash near Roswell, New Mexico. Michels states this himself, as support for the idea that a hidden government group managed recovered craft.
